title: Water treatment
description: Ozone is the most effective and eco-friendly water treatment method. 95% of drinking water in Europe is treated with ozone. It does not form dangerous byproducts like chlorine.

wastewater.title: Wastewater
wastewater.shortDesc: Deep treatment and disinfection of effluents
wastewater.heroDesc: Deep treatment and disinfection of effluents without toxic byproducts
wastewater.content:
Wastewater ozonation provides deep treatment of organic pollutants, pathogens and odors. The method is used as a final treatment stage before discharge to water bodies or reuse.

Ozone is a strong oxidizer that effectively breaks down complex organic compounds, including phenols, oil products and surfactants. Oxidation converts soluble pollutants to insoluble forms for subsequent filtration.

Advantage over chlorination: ozone does not form toxic chlorinated organics that harm aquatic ecosystems. After treatment, water is safe for discharge without long dechlorination.

The method is especially effective in oil-bearing regions where water contains high organic loads and color. Ozone removes color and odors, improving treated water quality.

intro.paragraph1: Wastewater ozonation is a modern method of deep treatment used as a final stage before discharge to water bodies or water reuse. Ozone is a powerful oxidizer that effectively breaks down complex organic compounds, providing disinfection without forming toxic chlorinated organics.
intro.paragraph2: The method is especially effective for treating industrial effluents containing phenols, oil products, surfactants (SAS), pesticides and other hard-to-oxidize organic compounds. After ozonation, water is safe for discharge to water bodies without long dechlorination.

ecologicalAdvantage.label: Ecological advantage:
ecologicalAdvantage.text: Unlike chlorination, ozone does not form toxic chlorinated organics that are dangerous for aquatic ecosystems. After treatment, ozone decays to oxygen, additionally aerating the water.

technicalParams.title: Wastewater ozonation technical parameters
technicalParams.caption: Recommended ozone doses depending on effluent type

highlightBox.label: Ozone dose calculation:
highlightBox.text: 1-3 g ozone per 1 g BOD (biochemical oxygen demand), 7-10 g ozone per 1 g oil products. Exact dose is determined experimentally for specific effluents.

steps.title: Mechanical treatment
steps.description: Removal of coarse impurities, sand, suspended solids. Mandatory stage before ozonation.

steps.title: Biological treatment
steps.description: Aerobic or anaerobic biological treatment to reduce BOD to 15-30 mg/L. Ozonation is applied after this stage.

steps.title: Ozone generation
steps.description: Production of ozone from oxygen by corona discharge method. Ozone concentration in gas: 6-12%.

steps.title: Contact chamber
steps.description: Mixing ozone-air mixture with effluents through bubbling system. Contact time: 10-30 minutes depending on contamination level.

steps.title: Clarification
steps.description: Settling or filtration to remove oxidized insoluble compounds.

steps.title: Quality control
steps.description: Analysis of treated water for compliance with discharge standards: BOD, COD, suspended solids, coliform index.

pollutants.title: Pollutants removed by ozonation
items: Phenols and nitrophenols: oxidation to CO₂ and H₂O, reduction to MPC levels
Oil products: destruction to simple organic acids
Pesticides and herbicides: oxidation to non-toxic compounds
Dyes and pigments: complete effluent decolorization
Pathogenic microflora: inactivation of bacteria, viruses, helminth eggs
Hydrogen sulfide and mercaptans: elimination of unpleasant odors

results.title: Wastewater ozonation results
results.caption: Domestic effluent treatment effectiveness (experimental data)
results.paragraph: Data obtained when treating effluents with ozone dose of 50 mg/L in contact chamber with contact time of 15 minutes. At ozone doses above 50 mg/L, color, turbidity and odor disappear, coliform index decreases to regulatory values.

items.title: Waste-free process
items.description: Ozone is synthesized from air oxygen and decays back to oxygen. No reagent purchase or storage required.

items.title: Universality
items.description: Effective against any organic pollutants: phenols, oil products, surfactants, pesticides.

items.title: Ecological safety
items.description: Does not form toxic byproducts. Water is safe for discharge to water bodies without dechlorination.

items.title: Reuse
items.description: After ozonation, water can be used for technical purposes: irrigation, washing, cooling.

highlightBox.text: Legislation imposes strict requirements on discharged effluent quality. Non-compliance entails fines up to 250,000 rubles for legal entities. Ozonation ensures guaranteed achievement of regulatory indicators.
